name: @pipeworx/mcp-rocketreach

tools.name: rocketreach_find_phone
tools.description: Find a person's phone number via RocketReach, by name + current employer (or linkedin_url / email). Prefers a recommended direct-dial number when more than one is on file. Example: rocketreach_find_phone({ name: "Patrick Collison", current_employer: "Stripe", _apiKey: "your-rocketreach-key" })

name.description: Person's full name, e.g. "Patrick Collison". Required together with current_employer unless linkedin_url or email is given.

current_employer.description: Company name the person currently works at, e.g. "Stripe".

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL — can be used instead of name + current_employer.

email.description: Optional known email address — can be used instead of name + current_employer.

_apiKey.description: Your RocketReach API key (generate one on your Account Settings page).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-rocketreach forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the rocketreach pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
